data_processing: Differential gene expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 (version 1.24.0), excluding genes with fewer than 10 counts average across all samples.
For plotting purposes, a variance-stabilizing transformation was applied using DESeq2, setting the 'bind' parameter to 'FALSE'
Pseudoalignment to Ensembl GRCh38 (version 98) cDNA reference using Kallisto (version 0.46.0) with optional parameter: --bias
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include normalised counts (generated using DESeq2 'counts()' function) for each sample
Transcript abundance estimates were summarised to gene-level counts using Tximport (version 1.12.3)

series_overall_design: 24 samples derived from two cell lines; a Friedrich's ataxia cell line (GM04078) and a healthy control line (GM03440). Untreated, DMSO treated, inactive compound treated and A-196 treated (3 different concentrations) analysed. Three cell culture replicates of each condition included.
SGC2043 is the inactive structural analogue of A-196
